name: Lukos the Exile
bio: Lukos is a lover of adventure, wine, and women — or he was, until he was seen with a Duke's wife at the local tavern. The jealous Duke framed him for murder and set every sheriff in the Empire on his heels. Now Lukos must scrounge what he can to clear his name… and get his payback.
